model_annotation: The chart illustrates the effect of various language families on different models, comparing the performance across multiple categories. The horizontal axis represents the language families, labeled as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, in a fixed order. The vertical axis is labeled "effect" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 5 and 10, and minor ticks at intervals of 2 and sometimes 1, and no units are specified. Each language family is represented by a group of six bars, colored according to the legend: mBERT-L2 (light blue), XLM-L2 (dark blue), mBERT-R2 (light green), XLM-R2 (dark green), mBERT-B2 (light red), and XLM-B2 (dark red), with error bars extending from the top of each bar. The bars within each group are arranged in the same order as the legend, and their heights vary across language families, with the tallest bars generally found in the IE-Indic category, reaching approximately 25 for mBERT-B2 and XLM-R2, and the shortest bars in the Isolate and Uralic categories, with values close to 0 for most models. The chart does not display any specific sorting order among the language families, and no bars are visually emphasized.
